title: Automatic Strap Folding Machine
description:
Development of an Automatic Strap Folding Machine integrated with Bartack sewing operations.

The project focuses on developing an automated machine solution to support the strap folding process and its integration with the Bartack operation.

My involvement includes machine development, automation engineering, technical problem-solving, and system integration.
technologies: Industrial Automation, Machine Development, Electrical Engineering, Machine Integration
